description: Ask Amazon whether it would take the photos and GPSR contacts of up to 25 products on their EXISTING Amazon offers — Amazon's own dry run (VALIDATION_PREVIEW), which changes nothing. Per product: status (ready = Amazon would accept; nothing = nothing to send, see skipped; blocked = no offer to write to, see reason: noListing, removedFromChannel, syncPaused, listingNotFound, variationParent; rejected = Amazon refused it, see issues in the marketplace's language; failed = the call failed), the attributes it would send, and skipped (noImages, noManufacturer, noResponsiblePerson, noTexts, noDocuments, or the product type does not take that attribute: textsNotInSchema, documentsNotInSchema). GPSR companies are set on the brand or supplier (assign_economic_operators), Amazon texts with set_amazon_listing_texts, safety documents with set_product_safety_documents. Needs a listing marketplace chosen on the Amazon connection; no arming. Then send with update_amazon_listing_content. Use inspect_amazon_listings first to find offers Amazon flags.

parts.description: What to send: images (the product's main photo and up to 8 more, replacing Amazon's), gpsr (the manufacturer and the EU responsible person, as the emails of records the seller created in Seller Central — taken from the product's brand, else its supplier), texts (the title and bullet points written for Amazon with set_amazon_listing_texts — nothing is sent when none were written) and documents (the product's safety PDFs, set with set_product_safety_documents). Default: all four; a part with nothing to send is reported in skipped.

productIds.description: The products whose Amazon offers to update, at most 25 ids from search_products or inspect_amazon_listings.

items.description: A product id returned by search_products.
